claim_traces.claim_text: "mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter or permanently change human DNA."
reasoning_steps: The claim that mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter human DNA is scientifically false

According to molecular biology and public health agencies, mRNA delivered by vaccines functions exclusively in the cell cytoplasm to produce the spike protein and cannot enter the cell nucleus where genomic DNA resides
Furthermore, mRNA lacks the reverse transcriptase enzyme required to convert RNA into DNA, and the vaccine mRNA degrades naturally within days after cellular delivery.

claim_traces.claim_text: "Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short — around 5 feet 2 inches tall."
reasoning_steps: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short at around 5 feet 2 inches is a widespread historical misconception
At the time of his autopsy on Saint Helena, his height was recorded as 5 feet 2 inches in pre-metric French units (*pieds de roi*)

Because a French inch (*pouce*) was approximately 2.71 cm (longer than the English inch of 2.54 cm), this measurement translates to approximately 5 feet 6.5 inches (168–169 cm) in modern imperial units

Given that the average height for an adult French male in the early 19th century was roughly 5 feet 4 inches to 5 feet 5 inches (162–165 cm), Napoleon was of average or slightly above-average height for his era

The enduring myth of his diminutive stature was largely popularized by direct mistranslation of French measurements into British imperial units, British wartime political cartoons (notably by James Gillray portraying "Little Boney"), and his affectionate military nickname "le Petit Caporal" (the Little Corporal).
